name: Matt Romano
biography: Matt Romano was born on January 12, 1993. He is an actor, known for Up in the Air (2009), Ice Age: The Meltdown (2006) and Made for Love (2021). He has been married to Erica Markle since April 6, 2024. Matt is also the son of comedian/actor Ray Romano and his wife Anna Romano.
